# Midday alert — Mon 2026-11-23 (~12:30 PM ET)

**Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; AI/semis rip.** NVDA +32%, MU +19.5% as of ~11:31 AM ET; Nasdaq +6.8%, S&P +5.0%, Dow +3.3%, 10Y −12bp to 4.92% ([Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/11/23/stock-market-midday-nov-23-nasdaq-surges-nearly-7-as-jensen-huang-s-return-sparks-historic-ai-rebound/), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/22/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)). ZS +15% / CRWD −11% on the deal.

**Desk read (long-only swing):** Don't chase. NVDA, MU and the AI-hardware group stay on avoid to 11/30 (gap >5%, sector-shock bounce; lessons 10/23, 11/06). Re-review after DELL/HPQ (11/24 AMC). Broad rally helps existing non-tech holds (TGT, TJX); no new longs, since PCE on Wed is the key risk. signals.json unchanged.
